findings.motion: Senate floor, Assembly 3rd Reading, AB 1116 (voter registration)
findings.note: Senate floor vote on AB 1116, Elections: voter registration, which lets a person without a California driver's license or state ID register to vote online by other means (the bill summary describes the last four digits of a Social Security number). Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record (Senate floor 29-9-2); she is listed among the yes votes. The bill was later vetoed by the governor, per the same page.
